# ORVIXA GAMING

ORVIXA GAMING adalah layanan top up game dan produk digital di Indonesia. Menyediakan top up diamond, UC, crystal, token, dan voucher untuk 6 game utama: Mobile Legends, Free Fire, PUBG Mobile, Genshin Impact, Magic Chess: Go Go, dan Call of Duty Mobile. Proses otomatis 24 jam, tanpa perlu login, pembayaran via QRIS, e-wallet (GoPay, DANA, OVO, ShopeePay, LinkAja), Virtual Account, dan Transfer Bank.

## Halaman Game

- [Mobile Legends](https://orvixagaming.net/mobile-legends): Top up diamond Mobile Legends murah, harga mulai Rp3.000
- [Free Fire](https://orvixagaming.net/free-fire): Top up diamond Free Fire harga terbaik, mulai Rp2.500
- [PUBG Mobile](https://orvixagaming.net/pubg-mobile): Top up UC PUBG Mobile, mulai Rp15.000
- [Genshin Impact](https://orvixagaming.net/genshin-impact): Top up Genesis Crystal Genshin Impact, mulai Rp16.000
- [Magic Chess: Go Go](https://orvixagaming.net/magic-chess-go-go): Top up token Magic Chess Go Go, mulai Rp3.500
- [Call of Duty Mobile](https://orvixagaming.net/call-of-duty-mobile): Top up CP Call of Duty Mobile, mulai Rp15.000

## Lainnya

- [Voucher Game](https://orvixagaming.net/#voucher): Voucher game digital dan gift card
- [Bantuan](https://orvixagaming.net/#bantuan): Cara top up, FAQ, dan hubungi kami
